careerLevel.description: Filter by career level (applied client-side against the extracted careerLevel).
careerLevel.title: Career Level

datePosted.description: Filter jobs by how recently they were posted (applied client-side against postedAtRelative / postedAt).
datePosted.title: Date Posted

employmentType.description: Filter by employment type (applied client-side against the extracted employmentType).
employmentType.title: Employment Type

keyword.description: Optional keyword filter. When set and no startUrl is supplied, builds https://www.bayt.com/en/international/jobs/?keyword=<query>.
keyword.title: Keyword

locationFilter.description: Optional country/city slug used to scope results (e.g. dubai-uae, uae, saudi-arabia, qatar). Combined with keyword builds https://www.bayt.com/en/<slug>/jobs/?keyword=<query>.
locationFilter.title: Location Filter

maxPages.description: Maximum listing pages to iterate over when collecting results.
maxPages.title: Max Pages

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy configuration. Datacenter proxy is sufficient — Bayt.com accepts datacenter IPs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

startUrl.description: Bayt.com search or category URL. Examples: https://www.bayt.com/en/international/jobs/python-jobs/, https://www.bayt.com/en/uae/jobs/, https://www.bayt.com/en/dubai-uae/jobs/
startUrl.title: Start URL
